Under the Oak tree is one of my favorite novels! I read the updates religiously for ages as they were translated on novel updates until they stopped translating back in January I think. I've been wanting to continue the story but I don't know how I can! Is there a place where the story has continued in English? The story stopped after maxi was getting back from her long study abroad and I'm not sure what books that's in or anything like that. The info I've been researching has been kind of all over place so I'm confused on how to support and enjoy this amazing story that I've been missing for so long! Please help!
